description:
## Related issues and PRs
Contributes to #119  

## Description
Adding e2e tests for the scenario selector
- select a different scenario
- the correct values are set in the population card
- the correct values are set in the epidemiology card

## Impacted Areas in the application
Tests

## Testing
run `yarn e2e` for a full test run
run `yarn e2e -s "**/scenario*"` to only run the scenario tests

![scenariospec](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6505742/78468822-3a772100-7756-11ea-8aca-9e1c4b7cf81b.jpg)

comments.body: There're **237** scenarios, running test on all of them will be time consuming, but if it' necessary we can remove this line and directly use `scenariosKeys` on line 49.
This line was changed recently, can somebody explain why? We can't use import in this file for now without adding some webpack loader configuration.

Well the commit  https://github.com/neherlab/covid19_scenarios/commit/1ee53fcdda989967b9a6c9175953efafac5d25d1 was by @abrie  with the comment ' Change 'require' to 'import' to fix eslint no-var-requires.'

Thanks @noleti.
I checked that PR but I don't know the reason, was this line breaking the build or something? Maybe @abrie can explain which part I need to change (worst case I'll just add a //eslint ignore).
I assume it was just eslint complaining: https://palantir.github.io/tslint/rules/no-var-requires/ . That being said, I'm no good in .js, so I can't comment on the path to take here.

@Joluma indeed it _was_ breaking the build because of a hard limit to eslint errors. But the fix breaks the 2e2 tests, which I don't think anybody has been running (until now). I agree with your solution to explicitly ignore the error.
